purpose: Distinguish AUTO/UNINITIALIZED key-pair state from EXPLICITLY_ALL_DISABLED state.

S0_auto_uninitialized.setup: No explicit manual key-pair override after load; allow normal safe auto inference.

S1_explicit_single_disabled.setup: Set exactly one valid pair trace_title<->trace_title with enabled:false.

S2_explicit_multiple_all_disabled.setup: Set multiple valid keyPairs (e.g. trace_title and trace_text), all enabled:false.

S4_invalid_or_missing_configuration_reco.setup: Load a new input for which configured fields are genuinely absent/invalid.
S4_invalid_or_missing_configuration_reco.expected_behavior: Existing reconcile behavior may auto-reinfer safe pairs; this is distinct from the user explicitly disabling valid pairs.

contract.explicit_valid_pairs_all_disabled: Matching is intentionally disabled; activeKeyPairs must be empty and accepted edge set must be empty.
